name: Claude
behavior: Does nothing by himself: no attack, no movement. On level start he spawns mini CLAWDS across the map - 5 on a small level, scaling with the level's tile count up to 15 on a very big one, placed by the terrain seed on walkable tiles, never on mines, the beacon, the hub or the pads, spread out. A clawd is not a gift: it never counts in a gift total, the straggler beam or the beacon. Collecting one (gift pickup radius) CALMS him: his anger timer resets to 0. If no clawd is collected for 60 s he releases a warning sound, at 120 s a second, more urgent one, and at 180 s he INSTA-KILLS the player (cause "Claude"). The timer runs in sim ticks, is in the state hash, pauses while the beacon is open and resets every level.
counter_play: collect clawds: each one resets the anger timer, so the swarm is the clock. The timer pauses once the beacon opens, so the gold phase is free - but the kill is real before it. His body still kills on contact: do not walk into him.
tell: a warning chime at 60 s and a louder alarm at 120 s; the HUD pill counts the clawds left and the seconds to the next warning
